role: State clearinghouse agency / draft EIS commenter
stance_basis: letter explicitly states no unacceptable natural resource damage will occur from the project
summary: The Illinois Natural History Survey reviewed the draft environmental statement for the Lincoln Highway widening project and concluded that no unacceptable natural resource damage would result. Their comment was brief and affirmative, raising no objections or conditions. No response from the agency or document preparers was necessary given the supportive nature of the comment.
complaint_summary: The Illinois Natural History Survey states that, based on its review of the environmental statement, it does not believe unacceptable natural resource damage will occur as a result of the project.

statement.text:
The Survey has reviewed the subject environmental statement and, on the basis of the information contained therein, does not believe unacceptable natural resource damage will occur as the result of the project.
Sincerely yours,
George Sprugel, Jr.
